title: Scope fixture copies environment-only directories
scenario: Run unittest discovery in this worktree containing ignored .aws and .codex directories.
expected: The baseline fixture excludes environment-only directories and passes inventory validation.
actual: test_current_repository_passes fails with unlisted top-level entries .aws and .codex; standalone check_scope.py passes.
evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py': exit 1; Ran 73 tests; failures=1, skipped=1. scripts/test_scope.py:11,18,33 copies the tree without Git metadata, triggering filesystem inventory fallback.
suggested_fix: Build the fixture from tracked/non-ignored repository files, excluding environment directories without reading their contents.

title: Cleanup retry assertions compete with the enabled cleanup scheduler
scenario: A cleanup scheduler tick occurs after the test enqueues its orphan and before its manually invoked failing cleanup processes it.
expected: Only the test-controlled failing storage and clock process this cleanup row.
actual: The integration context enables scheduling and does not disable the default-enabled cleanup job; its real-storage cleanup can mark the row DONE before assertions expecting PENDING/attempts=1. This is a source-confirmed timing dependency, not an observed local failure.
evidence: MediaCleanupIntegrationTest.java:84-95 constructs a separate cleanup with failing storage; support/IntegrationTest.java:17-20 disables other jobs but not cleanup; PlatformConfiguration.java:17 enables scheduling; MediaCleanupJob.java:9,18-20 defaults enabled and runs every 30s.
suggested_fix: Disable matbakhy.media.cleanup-job.enabled for this test context; isolate due rows for exact global runDue counts.
repro_test: Docker required: enqueue the orphan, invoke the application MediaCleanup bean before the test-controlled runDue, and observe DONE instead of PENDING. NOT_RUN locally.
